verdict.rationale: React is itself a developer library. Its docs cover official packages and APIs to build against: react-dom/client (createRoot, hydrateRoot), server rendering via react-dom/server and Node, React Native for mobile, and the installable React Compiler plugin. There is no evidence of an SDK story aimed at AI-native or agentic consumers, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404. missing for 10: explicitly branded official SDKs across languages or platforms, SDK documentation aimed at AI-native or agent workflows, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: createRoot lets you create a root to display React components inside a browser DOM node.
hydrateRoot lets you display React components inside a browser DOM node whose HTML content was previously generated by react-dom/server.
React can also render on the server using Node and power mobile apps using React Native.
Install React Compiler as a devDependency: npm install -D babel-plugin-react-compiler@latest
